questions.topic: Reading the sign of a magnification
questions.learningObjective: Explain how magnification sign relates to image orientation.
questions.stem: Explain how magnification sign relates to image orientation.

answer.exemplar: Magnification is image height divided by object height, so opposite signs mean the image is inverted relative to the object.

questions.explanation: The sign of m tells whether the image is upright or inverted relative to the object in this convention.
questions.hint: Negative means inverted.

questions.learningObjective: Explain why an object at the centre of curvature gives a same-size image.
questions.stem: Explain why an object at the centre of curvature of a concave mirror gives a same-size image.

answer.exemplar: At u=2f, the mirror equation yields v=2f, so object and image distances are equal and magnification is -1 in magnitude.

questions.explanation: At u=2f, v=2f and m=-1, so the image is same size and inverted for this mirror.
questions.hint: Set u equal to 2f in the mirror equation.
